name: dsh-plugin
description: Delta Suite, Delta Desktop and Delta Code: independent DeepSeek Harness plugins

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-code/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-suite/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-suite/tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-desktop/tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
scripts.build: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-code/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-suite/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-suite/tsconfig.client.json && node packages/dsh-delta-suite/scripts/finalize-client.mjs && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dsh-delta-desktop/tsconfig.client.json
